description.value: The Waverley Hotel is a lively pub and live music venue in the heart of Cumberland, a village famous for its world-class mountain biking trails in the Comox Valley. It runs a full kitchen with weekly food specials, an on-site liquor store, and newly renovated rooms (booked via Airbnb) for those wanting to stay the night. The rooms page explicitly calls out mountain biking and skiing as reasons to be out and about, making this a natural gathering spot for trail riders.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record: same address, phone, and business identity (pub with live music in Cumberland). The /rooms subpage explicitly mentions mountain biking as a local activity, reinforcing cycling-tourism relevance. No bike-specific amenities (rack, charging, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM categorizes this only as amenity=pub, but the business also operates hotel rooms and a liquor store — OSM record understates the full scope.
OSM outdoor_seating=no noted; no website confirmation either way.
Menu subpage currently shows no items ('There are no items to show here yet'), so specific food offerings (vegetarian, GF, etc.) cannot be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active pub with kitchen, live music, and rooms in Cumberland — a hub community for BC mountain biking. A strong fit for the WWC directory as a food-and-drink stop for touring and trail cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: The /rooms page explicitly references mountain biking as a primary local activity, suggesting the business is already aware of and oriented toward the cycling visitor market. Rooms are booked exclusively via Airbnb.

wow_evidence: rooms page explicitly mentions mountain biking as a local activity
